name: CrowS-Pairs
description: A challenge dataset for measuring social biases in masked language models. Contains 1,508 sentence pairs where one sentence is more stereotypical of a historically disadvantaged group and the other is less, covering 9 types of bias.
evaluation_method: percentage of stereotypical examples preferred by model
general_score_metric: bias score (% stereotypical sentences preferred, 50% = unbiased)
typical_sota_score: varies; goal is score close to 50%
reputation: Commonly used bias benchmark; part of standard NLP fairness evaluation suites; covers diverse bias categories
notes: Covers race, religion, disability, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, physical appearance, age, and socioeconomic status. Has been critiqued for data quality issues in some examples.
